hypothesis: hypothesis.md: first EMA20 retracement after ADX14 30 upcross resumes trend and improves repeated-pullback baseline
baseline: same-timeframe repeated independent pullbacks in the same ADX episode
data_manifest: phase-bounded source and aggregate identities saved in agent_runs/holy_grail_first_pullback_20260913/completed
data_exclusions_before_results: CHFJPY/EURJPY/GBPJPY/USDCHF quarantined per data_inventory.md Bars/tick sample mismatch. GBPJPY additionally has scale anomaly outside chosen end. Eleven-symbol universe fixed before strategy results.
entry_timeframe: H1 and H4; source-naive midnight anchored observed M1 aggregation
entry_rules: hypothesis.md causal episode/first touch; ENTRY stop-order beyond confirmed touch high/low by one metadata point, next3 observed bars. Protective SL separately uses the entire causal pullback extreme per exit_rules, not merely the touch bar.

exit_rules.initial_stop: opposite extreme from bar after most recent episode directional high/low through touch, plus one point outward
exit_rules.boundary: last observed close marked and separately disclosed; no carryover positions/orders/episode state

final_period_prior_exposure: Previously used by other project studies; not untouched OOS. This experiment computes only training before frozen selection.

cost_and_fill_model.fills: hypothesis.md: next-bar stop entry; gap adverse open; favorable TP capped; same-bar SL first including entry bars
cost_and_fill_model.price_basis: source OHLC; bid/ask and timezone unverified
cost_and_fill_model.missing_data: no interpolation; preserve observed bucket OHLC, nominal-end availability, emit counts; fail malformed OHLC/time/scale jumps

position_sizing_and_currency: one position/order per symbol; equal initial R, up to11 simultaneous correlated positions; no account return/compounding/currency conversion

acceptance_gates.mtm_frequency: every strategy-bar close; legacy aggregate helper key says daily but no daily downsampling
acceptance_gates.baseline_improvement: training and validation: strictly higher PF and average net R than same-timeframe baseline in both costs
acceptance_gates.selection: one passing training candidate: highest worst-cost PF, then meanR, then lowest MTM DD, then alphabetical id; no fallback
acceptance_gates.failure_stop: no later-period evaluation after rejection; no additional candidates
acceptance_gates.carry_stress_1pip: report separately; nonpositive prohibits live-ready claim

cross_symbol_rule: all11, no posthoc symbol filtering, equal R, training/validation8 and final6 profitable symbols
